programs.title: Euphoria
programs.desc: The further fate of a group of friends who left school behind and entered adulthood.The action moves forward several years.Rue (Zendaya Coleman) is no longer a lost teenager, but a person involved in the criminal world.He goes to interrogation in connection with smuggling drugs from Mexico.Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Maddy's (Alexa Demie) relationship has improved, but old wounds haven't healed at all.The first woman's relationship with Nate (Jacob Elordi) develops, but not towards a happy ending.The remaining characters confront their own choices, addiction and violence.They are looking for redemption and answers to the question about their place in the world.

programs.title: Lord Of The Flies
programs.desc: A film adaptation of William Golding's 1954 novel.A group of British boys on a desert island try to create fair rules.However, fear and power struggles lead to chaos and aggression.

programs.title: Wuthering Heights
programs.desc: Yorkshire.Catherine Earnshaw (Margot Robbie) begins a love relationship with the stray Heathcliff (Jacob Elordi), taken in by her father.The forbidden feeling has a destructive effect on both of them.

programs.title: Guess Who
programs.desc: Dark-skinned Percy (Bernie Mac) is the head of the Jones family and always knows what is best for his loved ones.He also has an opinion on what the future husband of his daughter, Theresa (Zoe Saldana), should be like.Unfortunately, so far none of her admirers have gained his recognition.When Theresa tells him about her new boyfriend, stockbroker Simon (Ashton Kutcher), her father finally seems to support her choice.However, at the first meeting, the good impression disappears.It turns out that Simon is... white.In addition, she does not ask Percy for her daughter's hand in marriage because he has already proposed to her.What's more, he wants to announce his engagement at the silver wedding of his future in-laws.Percy decides to make his daughter give up the marriage on her own.

programs.title: Hail Mary
programs.desc: Popular writer Maria (Laura Weissmahr) has recently become a mother.Her days are filled with caring for her son and visiting doctors.There is virtually no time left to create.To make matters worse, the husband keeps postponing the promised paternity leave and ignores the difficulties his wife is facing.At this time, Barcelona is shaken by information about the crime committed by a young French woman who drowned her 10-month-old twins in the bathtub.Maria follows this case with increasing attention, which slowly becomes her obsession.

programs.title: P.S. I Love You
programs.desc: After the death of her husband Gerry (Gerard Butler), Holly (Hilary Swank) falls into a deep depression.On her 30th birthday, a woman receives a mysterious parcel.The cake comes with a tape with a recorded message from... Gerry.He encourages his beloved to go out and have fun with friends.After this event, new letters regularly arrived to the young widow, each ending with a declaration of love.Gerry knew how much his wife would suffer from losing him.In letters written before her death, he encourages her to take on various challenges.Thanks to her extraordinary sense of connection with the deceased, a woman in despair undergoes specific therapy and tries to start her life anew.
